subject.title: All .large bubbles should have scrollable body regardless of truncation

question: Should native chat adopt always-on bounded inner body scrolling for large or tall bubbles, or should long native content use a different reader affordance?
rationale: Source inspection shows the requested behavior is still missing, but the permanent UX affects nested gestures, transcript scrolling, selection, accessibility, and streaming layout, so automation should not choose the interaction model alone.

options.title: Adopt Bounded Inner Body Scroll
options.body: Define the current tall-bubble rule and implement bounded body scrolling consistently in iOS and Android native chat with live proof for nested gestures and accessibility.

options.title: Use A Reader Affordance
options.body: Avoid always-on nested scrolling and provide a separate full-message reader or expansion surface for tall native content.

options.title: Defer Native Body Reader
options.body: Keep transcript-level scrolling only until maintainers decide the nested-scroll complexity is worth the UX change.

recommendation.title: Adopt Bounded Inner Body Scroll
recommendation.body: Define the current tall-bubble rule and implement bounded body scrolling consistently in iOS and Android native chat with live proof for nested gestures and accessibility.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already reviewed this issue and recently carried the native chat scroll paths on main, making him the best available owner for the product choice.
